name: 215 Mobile Detailing

reviews.text: Will and Braedyn did great. They were able to come out the same day I called and fit me into their schedule. Super nice and professional. Definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Alayna S

reviews.text: We had 215 Mobil detailing come out to detail our Ford Edge.  Will came out to our townhome and did an amazing job. He not only does good work but has a great personality. Our car looks fantastic. You can’t go wrong using him.
reviews.author: John Weigner

reviews.text: Will showed up exactly when he promised to be at our home. He did an amazing job on both our cars both inside and out.  He worked non-stop for 5 hours on our cars; paying extreme attention to every detail. He was very pleasant to chat with and made our cars look show room new.  Would highly recommend.  Will have him come back again without a second thought.
reviews.author: Rae Gommel

reviews.text: Will's communication was great to go along with his demeanor-- not to mention the quality of his work. My car looks great!  I had 3 family members inquire with him about getting a detail before he even pulled away.
reviews.author: Gregg Rappaport

reviews.text: Will detailed my car today and it looks exceptional! The attention to detail, truly remarkable. Will was very professional, he pulled up in my driveway with everything needed in his truck and got right to work. My car was truly a mess, I travel around with my dog and the hair was everywhere. I don’t even see a trace of it now. Thanks Will!! I would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Terry Monaghan
